note: Voiceover for SlateFilm. `f` is the frame the line starts on (30fps), and every `f` is the frame its CAPTION enters — the voice reads the on-screen line word-for-word so the two layers reinforce instead of competing. Line 06 is the one subset (the screen also says 'The change that broke it is gone.', which the voice leaves to the text because speaking it would cross the silence at the turn). Nothing speaks across f856–880: that silence is the loudest thing in the film. The stat sheet is not read aloud — numbers land faster on the eye than in the ear.

lines.text: You gave it write access to everything you own.
It wrote thirty-four files. You read none of them.
Every jump costs you the thread.
It writes a spec — the spec is open.
It edits code — the diff is open.
It moves files — the tree is open.
No model. No prompt. Sixty lines of Rust you can read yourself.
